description: This file declares interfaces and classes related to cryptographic cipher implementations, including base class CipherImplementation and derived classes Cipher and CipherNetflix, with methods for encryption, decryption, and cipher configuration.

classes.name: CipherImplementation
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for cipher operations, including Encrypt and Decrypt methods.

classes.name: Cipher
classes.description: Implementation of CipherImplementation for general cipher operations, supporting encryption, decryption, and cipher configuration.

classes.name: CipherNetflix
classes.description: Implementation of CipherImplementation for Netflix-specific cipher operations, supporting encryption and decryption.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using specified IV and key parameters.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data using specified IV and key parameters.

methods.name: Operation
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption based on the 'encrypt' flag.

methods.name: AESCipher
methods.description: Configures and returns an AES cipher mode.
